JobStatus.description: x-enum-varnames supplies the COMPLETE constant name, matching what oapi-codegen emits for the same file. Without it these would be JobStatusCreated, JobStatusQueued, and so on.

RunningStatus.description: Entries are often hand-prefixed to disambiguate members that would collide across sibling enums; Running here would otherwise clash with JobStatus's. They are honoured verbatim.

Partial.description: An empty entry means derive that one, so a schema can name only the members that need it.

NoExtension.description: No extension, so the derived names are unchanged.

Underscored.description: A name that is already a legal Go identifier is taken verbatim. Identifierize would reshape HTTP_Status into HTTPStatus, and renaming what the schema supplied defeats the point of the extension.
